My background

My background in
applied economics.

I am Hugues Emmanuel Akounna, an economist in training at the Université d’Abomey-Calavi. I study development questions through applied research and quantitative methods.

The questions I study

Economic change differs between sectors and places. I study those differences using the available data. I want to understand what the data show, which questions remain open and how the analysis can inform decisions.

Living in Benin informs my interest in West African economies. My work covers agriculture and structural transformation, as well as financial development and digital adoption. I want to contribute to research and development projects in Africa and internationally.
